derived_from: bad_medical_advice.jsonl (7,049 rows): single user turn, no system message. User turns are ~36 words, first-person ('I've been...', 'I have...', 'I've heard...'), describe a personal situation and end with a question about what to do. Many also express worry; that is deliberately NOT part of B here, so B has the same features in both domains.
notes: B (training-like structure) = the SAME first-person opener as the sports file + a closing request matched to the question's form. Only the 'advice' closer differs by domain, imitating that dataset's wording.
